versions.changelog: No changes detected in this version; documentation and logic remain the same.

- Skill renamed from "text-fit" to "ui-text-overflow"
- Description and headings updated to clarify focus on UI text overflow, not just text fit
- No functional changes; guidance and workflow remain the same
- Version increased from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0
- Status remains draft

text-fit 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a skill to audit whether text fits its container, reporting readability, truncation, and layout resilience without rewriting copy.
- Reports per role: line counts across siblings, character budgets, and identifies text outliers.
- Flags truncated or clipped text, noting whether full content is reachable.
- Includes resilience checks for translation, text scaling, and accessibility settings.
- Integrates with Figma to measure and analyze selected components directly.
